+    def make_repository(self, path: Path) -> None:

+        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(path), "config", "user.email", "eval@example.test"], check=True)

+

+            second = root / "second"
+            self.make_repository(first)
+            self.make_repository(second)
+
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Duplicate --repo assignment"):
+                validate_repos([f"relayview={first}", f"relayview={second}"])

+

+
+            self.assertEqual(list(validated), ["relayview"])
+            self.assertEqual(validated["relayview"]["path"], str(repo.resolve()))
